changelog: Paraphrased C4 to a much shorter summary of common German cohesion failures so we free space while preserving the judgement.
Paraphrased C7 to a concise statement of what drives contra in German, reducing length without changing meaning.

Changed C9 to add the primary finding: prefer very-early cuts after initial clause-introducers unless the remainder contains explicit qualification/negation/scope-bearing material; kept the reminder to judge by meaning, not token lists.

Changed C17 to keep the high-contradiction definition but make predicate-ending penalties explicitly conditional (only apply when remainder can change the prefix's asserted meaning); allow harmless dense cuts otherwise.

Insert a new Core Principle that (a) prefers very-early cuts after initial clause-introducing words unless the remainder contains explicit qualification/negation/scope carriers, and (b) makes penalties for predicate-ending prefixes explicitly conditional on the remainder containing clause-level qualifiers/negation/scope — directly addressing the primary finding about overbroad predicate-ending penalties and the underweighting of early clause-introducers.

Delete E1 to remove a hand-written example that encouraged premature cuts and contributed to the size overrun; this addresses the history/blame that E1 shifted the model toward harmful early/inside-NP cuts.
Delete E2 to remove a large hand-written example (Northern-Rock) that increased prompt length and pushed the prompt over the size budget.
Delete E3 to remove another large hand-written example (Bobek...) that both contributed to the size overrun and was blamed in prior iterations for encouraging unwanted segmentation behavior.

Insert a new Core Principle directing the scorer to prefer very-early cuts after initial clause-introducers when safe and to make predicate-ending penalties explicitly conditional on the remainder containing clause-level qualifiers/negation/scope carriers — this addresses the primary finding that a blanket predicate-ending penalty and underweighting of clause-introducers harmed mid-length bins.
